in_marathi.name: Kamalnayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamalnayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kamal means lotus, Nayan means garland. This name signifies a person who is adorned with the lotus of knowledge or spiritual growth. It is a name of Lord Krishna and is also believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
